results.notes: Full 2,035-task run; VQA judge: GPT-6 Luna via OpenRouter. No successful renders recorded for Matplotlib, TOML, Typst. Recorded failures remain included in scores. Ollama local generation, temperature 0, 8,192-token context and output limits; checkpoint quantization was not recorded. results.name: Gemma-Nemotron 4B BF16 EA
results.release_note: Non-public Early Access checkpoint (v1.0.0-ea), confirmed by the evaluation owner. Public release date and vendor-reported total parameter count are not documented. The 4B checkpoint name is not treated as a verified total parameter count.
results.notes: Full 2,035-task evaluation of the BF16 v1.0.0-ea checkpoint served locally with vLLM, thinking disabled, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, and 8,192 output tokens. GPT-6 Luna rejudged the saved outputs and rendered images; the original self-judged scores are not used. No successful Typst renders were recorded; failures remain included in scores.
